purpose: Packed WordPiece text adds token, absolute position and sentence segment embeddings. Twelve bidirectional attention and GELU FFN blocks produce contextual token vectors. A downstream task head selects sentence labels, token labels or answer spans. Pretraining and task adaptation share the encoder but not a universal output head.

purpose: The dotted arrows in Figure 1 transfer pretrained parameters, not predictions. The downstream panels share the encoder design but attach different task heads; fine tuning updates the encoder as well as the selected head.
alt: BERT pretraining predicts masked tokens and sentence relationships; separate downstream models reuse its encoder with classification, token labeling or answer span heads.
